recentItems.title: Neil deGrasse Tyson Fact Checks Interstellar
recentItems.description:
Astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson rewatches 16 sci-fi movies and reveals just how accurate Hollywood’s take on the cosmos and beyond really is. From Christopher Nolan’s beloved _Interstellar_ (hat tip to Prof. Kip Thorne) to the 2026 box office hit _Project Hail Mary,_ the StarTalk host breaks down scenes from the most popular sci-fi movies.

recentItems.title: Tim Robbins Breaks Down His Most Iconic Characters
recentItems.description:
Tim Robbins joins GQ as he revisits some of the most iconic characters from his career so far: from his breakout role as Nuke LaLoosh in _Bull Durham_ to his portrayal of Andy Dufresne in Frank Darabont’s critically acclaimed _The Shawshank Redemption._

“As an actor, you have to pursue the truth of what you believe is on the page. You have to trust that instinct,” says Robbins as he reflects on the reported friction during filming of _The Shawshank Redemption._ Watch the full episode of GQ’s Iconic Characters as Tim Robbins breaks down his most iconic films.
